mentions.name: Frontend-Only JavaScript Forms Library
mentions.description: A frontend/Javascript-only forms library supporting rendering, form schema input, data output, validation, and formula/conditional logic. Created as part of a cost-effective alternative to expensive form tools, with support for nested data and conditionals such as visible/required/enabled-if.
mentions.problem: Existing form tools are expensive, paywall advanced features, and lack immutability, self-hostability/EU SaaS options, nested data, formulas, and conditionals.
mentions.audience: users frustrated by expensive form-building tools who need immutable, self-hostable forms with advanced features
mentions.source_excerpt: a frontend/javascript only forms library that supports all the rendering, form schema input, data output, validation and formula/conditional logic
